limitations: Current persisted dispatch hint bridges old memory rules; semantic and compound intent routing is step 2.
Saved journal is not full-model context: task retains 24 task messages; legacy helper uses four recent user instructions.
Journal receipt and task execution are separate transactions; unexecuted history never automatically replays.
Current request-ledger recovery proves known create/turn payload hashes; missing trimmed history, changed parameters or unknown contracts conservatively refuse association.
Unsent device-reply outbox is process-local; only server-acknowledged journal records are durable across exit.
SQLite-to-PostgreSQL migration tool predates music_conversations and safely refuses unknown tables; this step does not migrate production data.
No provider quality, real catalog recall, native IME manual experience, load, or public release readiness conclusion.
